summary: Largest mass evacuation in Mesa County SAR history: ~120 boaters plus six dogs evacuated overnight from the Colorado River between the Loma Boat Launch and Westwater, Utah, as the Snyder Fire burned toward the Ruby-Horsethief section; 11-hour operation launched ~4:30 p.m. Saturday after a separated rafting group was reported; jet-boat scouting, Union Pacific hi-rail rail vehicles and BLM ranger fire overwatch used after the river proved too shallow for rescue boats; no injuries among evacuees.
location: Colorado River, Ruby-Horsethief section (Loma Boat Launch to Westwater UT)
responding_agency: Mesa County Search and Rescue; Mesa County Sheriff Office; Union Pacific Emergency Operations Center; BLM rangers; Grand Valley Transit Authority
notes: MCSO reported 123 people evacuated; CPR reported 120 boaters, six dogs and one cat. Three wildland firefighters were killed in the broader Snyder Fire complex (Knowles Fire portion) — separate incident, not SAR subjects.
